consequence.statement: The item, listed under 'Other (Cleanup or Flake)', describes only a build-toolchain upgrade (Go to v1.24.4) and states no effect on deployed environments, so there is no operational consequence for an operator.

original.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 upgraded the Go toolchain used to build it to v1.24.4, a cleanup item with no operator-facing effect described in the release note.

decision.reason: [ev-5744baed396c] says only that Go was upgraded to v1.24.4. The release notes list it under 'Other (Cleanup or Flake)', and nothing in the evidence says anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or needs an operator step. Upstream classes this as a cleanup of the build toolchain, so 'none' (informational) fits better than any failure kind or behavior-change. Confidence is low because the note does not state outright that there is no runtime effect.
